name: Complex Ticket Management System Workflow

data.label: Ticket Submission Started
data.description: Initiates the ticket management workflow when a user submits a support request

data.label: Validate Ticket Data
data.description: Validates that all required ticket fields are complete and properly formatted

data.label: AI Ticket Classification
data.prompt: Analyze this support ticket and classify it: Title: ${processData.title}, Description: ${processData.description}. Determine: 1) Category (technical_support, billing, general_inquiry, bug_report, feature_request), 2) Priority (low, medium, high, critical), 3) Estimated complexity (simple, moderate, complex). Return as JSON.
data.description: Uses AI to automatically classify ticket category, priority, and complexity

data.label: Assign Ticket Number
data.description: Generates unique ticket ID and sets initial status to 'New'

data.label: Priority Routing Decision
data.description: Routes ticket based on AI-determined priority level

data.label: Critical Ticket Escalation
data.instructions: Immediately assign critical ticket to senior agent and notify management

data.label: Auto-Assign to Agent
data.description: Automatically assigns ticket to available agent based on category and workload

data.label: Queue Low Priority Ticket
data.description: Adds low priority tickets to queue for later assignment

data.label: Parallel Notification Gateway
data.branches: Send notifications to user and agent simultaneously
data.description: Triggers parallel notifications to all relevant parties

data.label: Notify User of Ticket Creation
data.description: Sends confirmation email to user with ticket number and status

data.label: Notify Assigned Agent
data.description: Notifies assigned agent of new ticket assignment

data.label: Join Notifications
data.branches: Wait for both notifications to complete
data.description: Waits for all parallel notification tasks to complete

data.label: Agent Investigation & Resolution
data.instructions: Investigate issue, communicate with customer, and work towards resolution

data.label: Status Check Decision
data.description: Checks current ticket status to determine next action

data.label: Response Timeout Timer
data.description: Triggers escalation if no response within 24 hours

data.label: Escalate Due to Timeout
data.instructions: Ticket has exceeded response time limit - review and reassign if necessary

data.label: AI Resolution Quality Check
data.prompt: Review this ticket resolution for completeness: Original Issue: ${processData.description}, Resolution: ${processData.resolution}, Customer Response: ${processData.customerFeedback}. Is this resolution adequate? Provide quality score (1-10) and recommendations.
data.description: AI analyzes resolution quality and provides feedback

data.label: Customer Confirmation
data.instructions: Please confirm if your issue has been resolved to your satisfaction

data.label: Reopen or Close Decision
data.description: Customer can confirm resolution or request to reopen ticket

data.label: Reopen Ticket
data.description: Changes ticket status back to 'In Progress' and reassigns to agent

data.label: Close Ticket
data.description: Finalizes ticket closure and updates audit trail

data.label: Generate Audit Trail
data.description: Creates complete audit trail of all ticket activities and status changes

data.label: Ticket Workflow Completed
data.description: Ticket management workflow completed with full audit trail

data.label: Error Handler
data.description: Handles any errors that occur during ticket processing and logs them

dataModels.name: Ticket
dataModels.description: Central data model capturing ticket details from submission through resolution with complete lifecycle tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue or request

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the ticket issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (e.g., open, in_progress, resolved, closed)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (e.g., low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket category

fields.name: submittedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who submitted the ticket

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: User ID of the support agent assigned to handle the ticket

relationships.description: Each ticket belongs to one category
Each ticket is submitted by one user
Each ticket can be assigned to one support agent

indexes.description: Index on status for filtering tickets by current state
Index on submittedBy for retrieving user's tickets
Index on assignedTo for retrieving assigned tickets

fields.name: createdAt

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is authored by one user

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a ticket in chronological order
Optimize queries for comments by a specific author

fields.name: ticketId

fields.name: commentId

routing.reasoning: Complex workflow with 8+ steps, multiple decision points, parallel paths (notifications, assignments), and branching logic (status transitions, user confirmations). Advanced forms needed for ticket submission with validation, file uploads, and conditional fields. SQL data model optimal for relational ticket-user-comment structure with normalized schema. Cross-platform mobile support for field agents. Ensemble strategy recommended to combine workflow complexity with advanced form validation and relational data modeling.
